title: Copy a file or directory with rsync
summary: Use rsync to copy files or directories. It is efficient because it only transfers changes, making it great for backups or moving large folders.

steps.explain: Copy a file or directory from source to destination. Use --dry-run first to see what would happen without actually copying.
